title: Collector-state-aware feature selection for IoT gateway flow monitoring
description: Open-source repository providing a fully reproducible implementation of collector-state-aware two-pass feature selection for flow monitoring at IoT gateways: a cost model mapping the Zeek FlowMeter features of RT-IoT2022 to per-flow collector state, a sliceable C flow collector with exactness checks, two-pass state selection (class-specific SHAP shortlisting and measured out-of-bag gain per byte with a stopping rule), and the complete cross-validated evaluation with all result files.
